title: A general recipe for data-adaptive anytime-valid envelopes for iterative algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2610.23570v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most convergence guarantees for iterative stochastic algorithms are stated at a fixed iteration count and do not justify stopping at a data-dependent time. Recent work has constructed anytime-valid envelopes that do, but deterministic envelopes are typically too conservative for practical stopping, and existing data-adaptive ones are derived case-by-case, each coupling a specific algorithm to a specific noise model and boundary construction. This paper provides a general recipe for constructing such anytime-valid data-adaptive boundaries for a large class of iterative algorithms. Performance measures of many of these algorithms satisfy a one-step recursion that reduces the entire error analysis to a single general requirement: time-uniform concentration for predictably weighted sums of noise. translated_title: 迭代算法的数据自适应任意时刻有效包络的通用构建方法
translated_abstract: 大多数针对迭代随机算法的收敛性保证都是在固定迭代次数处陈述的，无法为在数据相关的时刻停止算法提供合理依据。近期的工作构建了能够提供这种依据的任意时刻有效包络，但确定性的包络对于实际停止而言通常过于保守，而现有的数据自适应包络则是针对具体案例逐一推导的，每一种都将特定算法与特定噪声模型及边界构造耦合在一起。本文为一大类迭代算法提供了一个构建此类任意时刻有效、数据自适应边界的通用方法。这些算法中许多算法的性能度量满足一个单步递归关系，这将整个误差分析简化为一个单一的通用要求：对可预测加权的噪声和具有时间一致的集中性。我们通过一个强适应的 sub-ψ 条件将这一要求形式化，并借助连续与离散的混合……（原文摘要至此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个通用方法，可为一大类迭代算法构建任意时刻有效且数据自适应的停止边界，将误差分析统一归结为对可预测加权噪声和满足时间一致集中性这一单一要求，克服了以往确定性包络过于保守、数据自适应包络只能逐例推导的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a general recipe for constructing anytime-valid, data-adaptive stopping boundaries for a broad class of iterative algorithms, reducing the entire error analysis to a single requirement of time-uniform concentration for predictably weighted sums of noise.
